title: Incoming active slices in symmetric operadic families
statement:
Use symmetric operadic families, active simplices and their inert projections from [def-coef-symmetric-operadic-family], join slices of [lem-coef-infinity-slice-right-fibration], active concatenation from [lem-coef-active-operad-cocartesian-concatenation], and categorical equivalences of [lem-coef-joyal-model-structure]. Let $M^\otimes\to N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)\times\Delta^n$ be a small symmetric operadic family, $n\geq1$. Write $M_0^\otimes$ for its fiber at $0$. Let $\sigma:\Delta^r\to M^\otimes$ be an active simplex all of whose vertices have strictly positive $\Delta^n$-coordinate. Put $X=M_0^\otimes\times_{M^\otimes}M^\otimes_{/\sigma}$, and let $X_{\mathrm{act}}\subseteq X$ be the full subcategory of cones all of whose cross edges are active. The inclusion $X_{\mathrm{act}}\hookrightarrow X$ admits a left adjoint, given by the inert-active factorization of the incoming arrows. Write $J_b=M_0^\otimes\times_{M^\otimes}(M^\otimes_{\mathrm{act}})_{/b}$ for an incoming active slice.
For any object $b$ of positive coordinate over $\langle s\rangle$, and chosen inert projections $b\to b_j$, inert-active factorization gives an equivalence
$$J_b\simeq\prod_{j=1}^s J_{b_j}.$$
Under this equivalence the source tuple and the canonical cone to $b$ identify coherently with the concatenation of the source tuples and canonical cones to $b_j$. These identifications persist after applying any inert-preserving family map to a symmetric infinity-operad, including all cocone composition homotopies. For $s=0$ the product is terminal and its tuple is empty.
